archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL URBAN TRANSIT
description: A high-visibility, dark-mode taxi rank operations platform for South African minibus taxi ranks. Serves Admins, Owners, Marshals, Drivers, and Passengers with real-time queue management, QR scanning, fare updates, passenger safety lookup, and revenue export.

scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white
scales.caption: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, high-density tactical cards with 48px+ touch targets for rank pavement usability.
layout_and_spacing.navigation_header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0D14]/85 border-b border-[#263144] px-4 py-3

component_strategies.role_selector: Pre-login role grid [Admin, Owner, Marshal, Driver, Passenger] with distinct tactical icons, glowing border state on active selection.
component_strategies.live_queue_board: Realtime status board showing taxi queue order, vehicle reg number, driver photo, passenger count, departure status, and time joined.
component_strategies.qr_generator_modal: High contrast black & gold QR display with download, print, regenerate, and rank perimeter geo-check toggle.
component_strategies.sos_button: Big red high-visibility emergency trigger with double-confirmation modal for drivers in distress.
component_strategies.safe_taxi_lookup: Passenger instant reg plate verification widget with verified checkmark badge, driver details, and 1-click public share link builder.
component_strategies.revenue_export: Excel (.xlsx / .csv) revenue table export action for owners with date range filters.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal controls, row actions, status indicators) MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on mobile buttons and inputs.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant dark surface contrast. Text is always bright white (#F9FAFB) or amber/emerald accents against dark slate surfaces (#181F2C).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Dark Mode Only palette specified in 'colors'. Do not render light background screens.
Implement explicit role-based UI flow: Landing Page -> Role Selection -> Login -> First-Login PIN Change -> Role Dashboard.

Role dashboards must include: Admin (all master data tables), Owner (taxis, drivers, revenue + Excel export), Marshal (queue board, QR generate/print, fares, rank posts, geo-check, long distance count), Driver (live queue rank position, QR scan, DEPART, SOS button), Passenger (Taxi Reg Search, verification badge, share link).
Provide live WebSocket/mock real-time queue syncing between Marshal queue controls and Driver position screen.
Add Sonner toasts and Success/Error modal components for every state-changing action.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, select, table row, badge, and tab.
